description: claude-hr secret-leak guard: blocks Bash / PowerShell commands that would print credentials into the transcript. Fails open if claude-hr-hook is not installed.

hooks.command: sh -c 'command -v claude-hr-hook >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec claude-hr-hook bash-guard'
if (Get-Command claude-hr-hook -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { claude-hr-hook bash-guard; exit $LASTEXITCODE } else { exit 0 }
